name: Shopify theme code writer
why: Writes installable section code for a named theme, matching this kit's theme-section-builder skill.

name: Leftover app code finder
why: Finds scripts and snippets left by removed apps and the lines to delete.

name: Hero image loading fixer
why: Sets the top image to load first with code, the most common LCP fix on Shopify themes.

name: Theme script and style loader
why: Defers or delays scripts in theme.liquid and unblocks styles and fonts.

name: App script auditor
why: Marks each app keep, remove or delay from the app list and a speed report.

name: Speed fix ranker
why: Ranks speed fixes by orders gained per hour of work, the payback order used here.

name: Store speed report reader
why: Reads a PageSpeed report into field results per page and three fixes.

name: Monthly store speed keeper
why: Runs the monthly comparison of speed reports and new app scripts.

name: Pre-launch store checker
why: Checks go-live readiness and re-checks after each fix until a clear go or no-go.

name: Speed budget and sale check
why: Sets a speed budget, test routine and pre-sale checklist before a big sale.

name: Shopify store setup planner
why: Plans payments, domain and build order for a new store before the page plan.

name: Shopify theme picker
why: Shortlists themes against the store's must-haves before any custom code is planned.

name: Shopify Markets setup planner
why: Plans market groups, currencies, languages and tax settings for stores selling abroad.

name: Shopify landing page builder
why: Turns finished page copy into Shopify files with install steps.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Ranks accessibility gaps each quarter and checks last quarter's fixes.
